audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side all read "Syndra" while win[4], win[5], win[6] read "Azir" — and the full-layer whys for those rows already describe Azir winning (Emperor's Divide, Nashor's spike, full-build teamfight).
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Syndra x4 then Azir, Azir, Azir, matching the content layer and matching the whys. The full-layer side column is the stale copy, and it renders the opposite answer to the sentence beneath it.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side moved to Azir; whys already match so they stay.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called Unleashed Power a "flat percent-health execute", a magnitude the kit does not give.
audit.why: Riot's text for R is only "bombards an enemy Champion with all of her Dark Spheres" (120/100/80s, 675 range); the execute comes from Transcendent (P) upgrading it via Splinters of Wrath. Stating it as an unconditional percent-health execute overstates the kit.
audit.corrected: Spike rewritten around the real cooldown and the Splinter condition.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns held no number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and the range relationship that decides the lane was never stated.
audit.why: Dark Sphere is 800 range on a flat 7s; Scatter the Weak is 650 range on a flat 15s; Force of Will is 925 on 12/11/10/9/8s. Azir's Q is 740. The gap between her 800 poke and her 650 stun is the exact band Azir stands in, and her 15s stun is the punishable cooldown.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field and the Do's bodies now carry the real numbers and the range band.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page warned that resistances are the wrong purchase into her.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated: Transcendent upgrades Force of Will to deal bonus true damage, which ignores MR entirely.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] now says to buy HP rather than MR.

audit.why: 45.23% over 1238 games, consistent with the 8/10 difficulty already on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eleven fields called Syndra "he/his" (lint MISGENDER); dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim and dontsFull[2].d the tradeBad string verbatim, both under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists syndra as female; the templates were written for a male enemy.
audit.corrected: All flagged pronouns corrected and both bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles.
